title: Tour Consultant
description:
**Company Description**
Tourlux Holidays Private Limited is a travel and tourism company dedicated to creating memorable, well-planned holiday experiences for individuals, families, and groups. The company focuses on providing customized tour packages, reliable travel arrangements, and on-the-ground support to ensure smooth journeys. Tourlux Holidays collaborates with trusted partners and service providers to offer high-quality accommodations, transportation, and guided experiences. The team values professionalism, customer satisfaction, and attention to detail in all aspects of travel planning and delivery.

**Role Description**
The Tour Consultant is a full-time, on-site role based in Kochi. This role involves advising customers on travel options, designing customized itineraries, and preparing detailed tour proposals based on client preferences and budgets. The Tour Consultant coordinates bookings for flights, hotels, transportation, and guided tours, and ensures all travel documentation and confirmations are accurate and timely. Day-to-day tasks include responding to inquiries, providing destination information, managing reservations and changes, and handling customer queries before, during, and after travel. The role also includes maintaining up-to-date knowledge of travel trends, offers, and regulations, collaborating with internal teams and partners, and delivering a positive customer experience throughout the travel cycle.

**Qualifications**

* Strong Travel Consulting and Travel & Tourism knowledge, with the ability to design and manage customized tour itineraries.
* Experience in Guided Tours, including coordinating local experiences, activities, and sightseeing arrangements.
* Excellent Communication and Customer Service skills, with a customer-focused approach and professional demeanor.
* Attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple bookings and deadlines efficiently.
* Proficiency with travel booking systems, reservation tools, and basic office software.
* Diploma or degree in Travel & Tourism, Hospitality, or a related field is preferred.
* Prior experience in a tour operator, travel agency, or similar environment is an advantage.
* Ability to work on-site in Kochi, collaborate with team members, and adapt to peak travel seasons and changing customer needs.

description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.
  
  
We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

We are looking for a Senior Information Security Engineer to join our team. This is a Hybrid role, reporting to the Director, Software Development Engineering in the Engineering department.

* Track emerging threats and vulnerabilities and prioritize new playbook content accordingly
* Document scenarios clearly so engineers can implement and maintain them

* You foster a high-trust, collaborative environment that values transparent feedback, healthy debate, and shared team success above individual accolades.
* You champion the customer experience by anchoring engineering decisions in solving critical, real-world problems for both internal stakeholders and external users.
* You bring deep technical curiosity and an innovative mindset to solve complex architectural challenges, continuously seeking more resilient,
